programs.title: Desire: A Temptations Story
programs.desc: Caught up in a whirlwind romance, inspirational talk-show host Kendra spontaneously marries the man of her dreams. However, once the honeymoon is over, revelations about her new husband's past lead her down a dangerous road.

programs.title: Exhibiting Forgiveness
programs.desc: A Black artist finds his path to success derailed by an unexpected visit from his estranged father, a recovering addict desperate to reconcile. Together, they learn that forgetting might be harder than forgiving.

programs.title: Almost Unsolved Heists
programs.desc: After a series of unsolved robberies in Montreal, police think they have the right woman in custody, but bank robber "Machine Gun Molly" is still out there; when she attempts one final heist before her retirement, her final getaway goes sideways.

programs.title: Charmed to Death
programs.desc: Debra Proctor, a nurse and a pillar of her Cherokee community, meets a caring stranger online and falls in love; they have a happy marriage until the truth about who he really is causes her world to come crashing down.

programs.title: Targeted for Murder
programs.desc: When Jennifer Cave fails to show up at her new job, her family fears the worst; their fears are confirmed when they take their search for her into their own hands.

programs.title: Finally Caught
programs.desc: A quiet Tennessee couple returns home to a nightmare, burglars lurking in the shadows, a home invasion turning deadly.
